result.summary: The food delivery home screen has several layout and content problems: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped, a pizza card shows a broken -0% discount badge, and a restaurant name is truncated.

issues.description: The last visible category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge, implying a horizontal carousel without a clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add peek/padding and a fade or chevron so users can tell the filter row is scrollable, and keep the last fully visible chip from being clipped.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol) is clipped on the right and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Give the last card enough peek or wrap/scale the grid so names and images are fully readable, or use a two-line ellipsis that still shows the full restaurant name.

issues.description: The pizza card badge shows '-0%', which looks like a broken or empty discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0, or show a real offer (e.g. a percentage or 'Deal') instead of a meaningless -0%.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so the last card can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
